title: Overview
Core Metadata & Design System
text:
core metadata settings

initial settings associated with controls built into the interface:

type â is this a block level element or grid implying it can have things placed inside of it
canscale hide width scaler which common
caneditsource should users see inline view source button
hidedefaultsettings hides designsystem and textual alignment options commonly present
designsystem define if accent, primary, card, text (font), special design treatment form inputs be shown

"api": "1",
"type": "element",
"canscale": false,
"caneditsource": true,
"hidedefaultsettings": true,
"designsystem": {
  "accent": true,
 "primary": false,
 "card": "text": "designtreatment": false
}



gizmo

gizmo provides listing in hax editor filtering that allows button to render for click drag onto interface. data also shows up merlin when typing find related blocks.
"gizmo": "title": "block quote",
 "description": "a well designed quote image author",
 "icon": "editor:format-quote",
 "color": "blue",
 "tags": [
 "layout",
 "quote",
 "blockquote",
 "content",
 "design",
 "presentation"
 ],
 "meta": "author": "haxtheweb team"
 }
}

title: Settings & Input Methods
text:
settings provide the editing form fields user sees. this is a simplified version of json schema and supports property, attribute, or slot as far what it mapped to. title description are shown to on while inputmethod determines control rendered. 
organization input methods


tabs â visual wrapper which groups sub-fields into defined tabs, hiding non-active tabs
fieldset within border
array an array objects (users can dynamically expand with "add item" button)
collapse under collapsible tag




control methods


textfield text input
textarea resizeable multi-line input
alt alt data validation
url url validation
select select list
boolean checkbox
number number selector / validation
slider min, max, step for numerical input
radio single item select
color color (hex)
colorpicker (list)
iconpicker icon
code-editor monaco editor line-endings color-coding
fileupload file upload (not hax specific)
haxupload field wired talk appstore
date-time yyyy-mm-ddthh:mmz string
datepicker yyyy-mm-dd string
monthpicker yyyy-mm string
weekpicker yyyy-www string
timepicker hh:mmz timestamp

review source at haxfields.js latest additions.


settings has 3 possible properties hold generate. configure, advanced, developer correspond collapsed areas in form.
"settings": {
  "configure": [
 "property": "citation",
 "title": "description": "the citation element",
 "inputmethod": "textfield"
 },
 "alt",
 image",

 image "haxupload",
 "novoicerecord": true,

 }
 ],

}
organization designed more complex use case, purposefully grouping together. child items (sub-fields) assigned tag:
"settings": "skills",
 "associated skills",
 skills related "array",
 "itemlabel": "name",
 "hidereorder": "expanded": "hideduplicate": "properties": "skill",
 ]
 ]
}

title: Hax Hooks
text:
while haxproperties describes how an element appears in the gizmo browser and hax configures it via settings forms, haxhooks lets participate lifecycle / state changes without importing hax. this keeps elements decoupled from editor: opts into deeper integration by declaring a haxhooks() method that maps hook names to on element. // example @haxtheweb/media-image/media-image.js
haxhooks() {
  return editmodechanged: "haxeditmodechanged",
 activeelementchanged: "haxactiveelementchanged",
 mediasourceupdated: "haxmediasourceupdated",
 };
}
the store discovers these testhook runhook invokes them at right moment. callback name is your choice; convention + name.

available hooks


activeelementchanged â input (activeelement, value) where value whether active. see @haxtheweb/retro-card/retro-card.js
editmodechanged (value) edit-mode of body. @haxtheweb/retro-card/retro-card.js
inlinecontextmenu allows dynamically adding buttons editor context menu. @haxtheweb/multiple-choice/multiple-choice.js
gizmoregistration rewrite when registered with (e.g. register custom app, extend validgizmotypes). @haxtheweb/github-preview/github-preview.js
preprocessnodetocontent (node), item about be converted content for export. @haxtheweb/editable-table/editable-table.js
progressiveenhancement works only slotted innerhtml area; must content. @haxtheweb/meme-maker/meme-maker.js
postprocessnodetocontent (content), html blob returned @haxtheweb/video-player/video-player.js
preprocessinsertcontent inserted @haxtheweb/multiple-choice/multiple-choice.js
sitetoskeleton (details) details { uuidmap, direction }; rewrites its own site-item uuid references so skeleton structure stay sync. @haxtheweb/haxcms-elements/lib/ui-components/magic/site-collection-list.js
mediasourceupdated (path, store) path clean url file just modified place haxstore instance. @haxtheweb/media-image/media-image.js
processfileupload (values, response, invoked generic tray upload drag-drop after uploaded but before insertion. false decline, or mapping object run post-upload transform. @haxtheweb/slide-deck/slide-deck.js
